svg.text: Payments Engine, level 2: Rule 5 Allocation & Rule 6 Reversal
Worked mathematical scenario demonstrating oldest-first waterfall fill, surplus credit ledger, and unwound bills upon voiding.
Rule 5: ৳20,000 Payment Allocation
Payment Received: ৳20,000.00 (2,000,000 poisha)
Current Unpaid Bills: October (৳3,000 due, period 2026-10-01), November (৳14,000 due, period 2026-11-01)
Ordered lock: SELECT id FROM bills WHERE ... ORDER BY period_month ASC FOR UPDATE
1. October Bill (Oldest Unpaid)
Total Due: ৳3,000.00 | Allocated from payment: ৳3,000.00 | Remaining payment: ৳17,000.00
Result: bill.paid_poisha = 300,000 ➔ status: 'paid' (balance: ৳0)
2. November Bill (Next Unpaid)
Total Due: ৳14,000.00 | Allocated from payment: ৳14,000.00 | Remaining payment: ৳3,000.00
Result: bill.paid_poisha = 1,400,000 ➔ status: 'paid' (balance: ৳0)
3. Surplus / Overpayment Credit Ledger
Remaining Payment: ৳3,000.00 (300,000 poisha) with no further unpaid bills
Result: INSERT INTO credit_entries (kind: 'overpayment', amount_poisha: 300,000, payment_id)
Subsequent December Bill (৳14,000 issued):
Auto-applies ৳3,000 credit: credit_entries (-300,000, kind: 'applied', bill_id: DecBill)
Dec Bill: paid_poisha = 300,000, balance = ৳11,000.00, status: 'partially_paid'
Rule 6: Voiding the ৳20,000 Payment
Landlord Action: POST /api/payments/:id/void { reason: 'Wrong account' }
Single atomic transaction executed via app_void_payment() SECURITY DEFINER function
Immutable history rule: payments row updated to 'void', receipt updated to 'void'
1. Remove Payment Allocations
app_void_payment deletes payment_allocations matching payment_id
October alloc (৳3,000) & November alloc (৳14,000) deleted
2. Reopen Affected Direct Bills
Recalculates remaining allocations on October and November bills
October ➔ paid: 0, status: 'issued' | November ➔ paid: 0, status: 'issued'
3. Unwind Credit Applied to Later Bills
Overpayment credit (৳3,000) was already applied to December bill
Inserts reversed credit (+300,000, kind: 'reversed') or deletes applied entry
December Bill Reversion:
December Bill has credit removed: paid_poisha reverts from 300,000 ➔ 0
December status reverts from 'partially_paid' ➔ 'issued', balance: ৳14,000.00
